caveats.en: Slate Digital says its plug-ins are not compatible with Windows on Arm (Snapdragon) and recommends Intel/AMD PCs. Arm support is being explored with no date.
caveats.zh-TW: Slate Digital 表示其外掛與 Windows on Arm（Snapdragon）不相容，建議使用 Intel/AMD 電腦。Arm 支援仍在評估中，沒有時程。
